people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, just as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
